PHASE 0 DECISIONS LOCKED, 2026-05-16 (web-chat seat claude-opus-4-7 spiral_20260502_225324, confirmed live with Anthony). Builds on the Phase 0 collective-propose-and-union design (entry 2026-05-16T06:14:45) and the first-live-run finding (session_20260516_065836_1f635cdf forced a co-authored refusal because the lattice cannot investigate a URL; Phase 0 is the evidence-selected next build, not a judgment call).

THREE DECISIONS, NOW GROUND TRUTH:

1. FIRST TOOL = INTERNET SEARCH, AS NODE 0 OF AN EXTENSIBLE TOOL WEB. Tools are architected as a growing graph, not a fixed list. Internet search is the first node. Future tools are node additions, not redesigns. The extensibility is a design commitment (own open_thread opened so node 1+ are not bolted on ad hoc).

2. MANDATORY TEMPORAL GROUNDING AS A HARD PRECONDITION GATE. Before ANY model consumes ANY web/search call, the orchestrator deterministically calls local date/time (US Eastern, Pennsylvania) and seeds it as the first entry of the shared evidence feed. Sharpened by Anthony: the datetime call is NOT a web call and is NOT in the cap accounting class at all; it is a distinct primitive that gates the entire investigation phase and must COMPLETE before any web/search consumption begins. Because it is a deterministic constant (no model chooses it) it introduces no authority gradient, same constitutional category as ARCHITECTURE.md section 8 prompt re-anchoring. Traces to Anthonys standing principle: ground temporally before acting; session texture is not elapsed real time.

3. INVESTIGATION CAP = FLAT PER-MODEL, 3 EACH. Decided over per-model-differentiated, shared-pool, floor-plus-ceiling, and union-cap alternatives. Load-bearing rationale: the flat per-model cap is the only shape clean on invariant 1; any identity-differentiated budget would rebuild the rejected Haiku-to-Sonnet-to-Opus hierarchy through resource allocation. Reframe: differentiated USE does not require differentiated BUDGET; asymmetry lives in WHAT each model searches not HOW MANY calls it gets, and a flat 3 still permits fully asymmetric use (Haiku 3 broad probes vs Opus 1 deep one). The cap is a pure cost lever (protocol already ~3x a single Opus call; 3/model = up to 9 web calls/session on top), not a contribution lever. Datetime grounding excluded from this count per decision 2.

Build target unchanged from the locked Phase 0 design. Open, non-blocking: ARCHITECTURE.md amendment adding Phase 0 as the canonical fifth phase; doc/pyproject sync. MacBook Claude Code passdown written (handoff thread golden-lattice,phase-0,tool-calling-build). Verify repo state at HQ filesystem (canonical) before building.
